# Kuyfi — full documentation for LLMs and coding agents
# Source of truth mirror for https://kuyfi.vercel.app/docs
# Package: @kuyfi/kuyfi@0.1.0 | Command: kuyfi | License: MIT
# Author: Alex B. Hernández Contreras | Repo: https://github.com/alex0tico/kuyfi

================================================================================
1. PRODUCT SUMMARY
================================================================================

Kuyfi is an open-source black-box security terminal for Soroban (Stellar) smart
contracts. Tagline: "Before the Breach."

Purpose: automated pre-audit testing against a DEPLOYED Testnet contract. It
does not replace formal audits (Veridise, Ottersec, CoinFabrik, etc.) and does
not issue certifications.

Black-box meaning: Kuyfi never requires Rust source. Knowledge comes from:
  - on-chain WASM bytecode
  - contractspecv0 XDR custom section (functions, types, UDTs)
  - runtime behavior under simulation and optional Testnet invocation

Stack: TypeScript, Node.js >= 20, React 19, Ink 6, @stellar/stellar-sdk,
Express (optional server), pdfkit, meow, @x402/express, local402-server.

================================================================================
2. INSTALL & INVOKE
================================================================================

npm install -g @kuyfi/kuyfi

Interactive TUI:
  kuyfi

Headless:
  kuyfi <CONTRACT_ID>
  kuyfi <CONTRACT_ID> --json
  kuyfi <CONTRACT_ID> --pdf
  kuyfi <CONTRACT_ID> --json --pdf

From source:
  git clone https://github.com/alex0tico/kuyfi.git
  cd kuyfi && npm ci && npm run build
  npm start                          # TUI
  node dist/cli.js <CONTRACT_ID>     # headless

Windows PowerShell note: if .ps1 is blocked, use kuyfi.cmd / npm.cmd.

Contract ID validation: /^C[A-Z0-9]{55}$/

Binaries:
  kuyfi         → dist/cli.js
  kuyfi-server  → dist/server.js

================================================================================
3. PIPELINE
================================================================================

01 INPUT          Contract ID
02 OSINT SCANNER  Fetch deployed WASM / specification (read-only RPC)
03 RECONSTRUCT    Attack surface (functions, params, UDTs)
04 CHAOS MONKEY   Generate type-aware vectors
05 SIMULATE       Simulate and classify DiagnosticEvent traces
06 OUTPUT         JSON / PDF SecurityReport

Narrative: The OSINT Scanner maps functions, arguments and user-defined types
first. Chaos Monkey then generates type-aware inputs, simulates execution and
classifies the resulting traces. When an execution reaches the network, Kuyfi
preserves the available transaction evidence alongside the report.

Architecture rule: UI ≠ audit engine. Screens only call source/modules/.
Headless CLI uses the identical scanner / chaos_monkey / security_report /
report_export functions.

================================================================================
4. OSINT SCANNER
================================================================================

Read-only: getContractWasmByContractId — no transactions.

Steps:
  1. Fetch WASM
  2. WebAssembly.compile + customSections('contractspecv0')
  3. Alignment-tolerant XDR parse of ScSpecEntry stream
  4. Build ScannedFunction[] + UdtRegistry

ScanResult { contractId, bytecodeSize, functions, udtRegistry }
ScanError codes: CONTRACT_NOT_FOUND | XDR_ALIGN_FAILURE | RPC_UNAVAILABLE | UNKNOWN

Paid HTTP (optional kuyfi-server):
  GET /scan/:contractId
  → 402 Payment Required (CLP priced via Local402 / Reflector → USDC)
  → 200 OK with public scan block
  Chaos Monkey is NEVER exposed over HTTP.
  Malformed ID → 400 before quote.
  Failed scan after pay (404/422/502) is not settled.

Env: PAY_TO (public G…), PRICE (default "500 CLP"), NETWORK (stellar:testnet),
FACILITATOR_URL, PORT (4021).

================================================================================
5. CHAOS MONKEY
================================================================================

Not random dumb fuzzing. Type-aware attack values from XDR ScSpecTypeDef.
One variable at a time; other params hold type-correct baselines.

Constraint: type-correct ≠ semantically valid (random Address ≠ admin).

Vector families:
  - Math/boundary (fuzzer_math): ZERO, ONE, NEG_ONE, MAX/MIN, EMPTY/LARGE, UDT field attacks
  - Access (fuzzer_access): UNAUTHORIZED_CALL, REINIT_ATTACK, SELF_CALL_ATTACK,
    UNAUTHORIZED_ADDR_CALL; admin name patterns (initialize, set_admin, upgrade, …)
  - Call order (fuzzer_call_order): REINIT_SEQUENCE, REPEATED_WITHDRAW/CLAIM
  - Fee/BPS (fuzzer_fee): BPS_* boundaries on fee-shaped params
  - Liquidity (fuzzer_liquidity): ZERO_A_MAX_B etc. on swap/reserve-shaped fns

Execution:
  vector → simulate
    fail → classify from diagnostics (nothing sent)
    ok   → assemble → sign ephemeral Friendbot key → broadcast Testnet → poll → classify

Keys: generated in memory, never persisted or logged.
Network constant: https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org

Modules of note: keypair_factory, type_gen, udt_registry, router.invokeContract,
trace_analyzer, result_parser, reporter (KYF-NNN IDs).

================================================================================
6. SIGNALS & SEVERITY
================================================================================

SECURE              Expected rejection / accepted non-AC vector. Filtered from findings list.
PRECONDITION_FAIL   Missing setup / structural auth fail. Filtered from findings list.
UNEXPECTED_ERROR    Inconclusive failure. MEDIUM. In findings.
POTENTIAL_VULN      Security signal needing review (AC not rejected, nested safety faults, …).
                    CRITICAL if admin-pattern name else HIGH. In findings. NOT a confirmed exploit.
UNCONTROLLED_PANIC  Root safety trap without nested calls. MEDIUM.
TIMEOUT             Poll window miss. LOW.

Legacy SIMULATION_FAIL exists on the type but is never emitted by the classifier.

Trace categories: AUTH | CONTRACT | CONTEXT | OBJECT | STORAGE | WASM_VM | OTHER | UNKNOWN

================================================================================
7. REPORTS
================================================================================

SecurityReport schemaVersion "1.0.0"
JSON and PDF are renders of the SAME object (shared reportId).

Evidence includes:
  - counters (vectors, broadcasts, hashed txs)
  - per-finding simulation/broadcast flags + DiagnosticEvent trace
  - hash, ledger, stellar.expert URL when broadcast
  - verificationTransactions sample (first success + first fail broadcast)

TUI keys after Chaos Monkey: [J] JSON [P] PDF [B] both
CLI flags: --json --pdf

================================================================================
8. TUI
================================================================================

Ink React app. Menu:
  [1] OSINT Scanner
  [2] Chaos Monkey
  [3] System Logs
  [4] About

Layout modes: large (>=100 cols), compact (70-99), tooSmall (<70 or <20 rows).
Shrink-resize recovery via useTerminalSize (debounce + ANSI clear without
unmounting in-flight work).

================================================================================
9. RESPONSIBLE USE
================================================================================

- Only authorized targets
- Testnet only
- Findings ≠ audit certificate
- Unauthorized fuzzing may be illegal / ToS violation

================================================================================
10. ROADMAP (high level)
================================================================================

Shipped: OSINT Scanner, Chaos Monkey (5 families), reports JSON/PDF, headless CLI,
npm publish, responsive TUI, paid scan endpoint (unreleased notes may vary).

Planned/not committed: richer semantic inputs, more patterns, CI integrations.
Explicitly out of scope: Mainnet, other chains, SaaS certification platform.

================================================================================
12. AGENT PLAYBOOK (SHORT)
================================================================================

1. Read this file / llms.txt before inventing APIs.
2. Confirm authorization + Testnet.
3. Prefer: kuyfi <ID> --json
4. Explain POTENTIAL_VULN as investigate-first.
5. Never claim Mainnet support or that Kuyfi replaces formal audits.
6. Point humans to https://kuyfi.vercel.app/docs for UI docs.

================================================================================
13. VECTOR CATALOG (SUMMARY)
================================================================================

Math (fuzzer_math): OAT mutations — ZERO/ONE/NEG_ONE/MAX_*/MIN_*, RANDOM_ADDR_A/B,
EMPTY/LARGE bytes/strings, EMPTY_VEC, NONE/SOME_BASELINE, recursive UDTs.
Names like amount::MAX_I128 or p::Point.x::ZERO.

Access (fuzzer_access):
  UNAUTHORIZED_CALL, REINIT_ATTACK, SELF_CALL_ATTACK, UNAUTHORIZED_ADDR_CALL
Admin name substrings: pause, unpause, initialize, init, setup, upgrade,
set_admin, set_pending_admin, transfer_admin, emergency.

Call order (once/session): REINIT_SEQUENCE, REPEATED_WITHDRAW_SEQUENCE,
REPEATED_CLAIM_SEQUENCE.

Fee: BPS_* on fee-shaped numeric params (0,1,9999,10000,10001,type max).
Liquidity: paired extremes ZERO_A_MAX_B / MAX_A_MAX_B on swap/reserve-shaped fns.

Full page: https://kuyfi.vercel.app/docs/vectors

================================================================================
14. SCAN ERROR CODES
================================================================================

CONTRACT_NOT_FOUND  — no WASM for ID on Testnet
XDR_ALIGN_FAILURE   — contractspecv0 parse failed
RPC_UNAVAILABLE     — transport / endpoint
UNKNOWN             — catch-all

Troubleshoot: https://kuyfi.vercel.app/docs/troubleshooting
Glossary: https://kuyfi.vercel.app/docs/glossary

================================================================================
15. DOCS SEARCH (HUMANS)
================================================================================

Docs UI search (Cmd/Ctrl+K or /): fuzzy matching, EN/ES synonyms
(instalar→install, informe→report, vulnerabilidad→POTENTIAL_VULN),
section deep-links, suggested chips.

================================================================================
16. MARKDOWN FOR AGENTS (NOT MDX)
================================================================================

MDX = Markdown + JSX components (UI authoring format).
Markdown for Agents = plain Markdown optimized for LLMs/agents.

Kuyfi provides:
- Page options → Copy as Markdown / View as Markdown (every HTML docs page)
- Per-page: https://kuyfi.vercel.app/docs/md/<slug>.md
- https://kuyfi.vercel.app/docs/agent-setup
- This file + llms.txt

Do NOT tell users that "MDX = Markdown for machines." That is incorrect.

End of llms-full.txt
